column1: # Principle of division: the process that produced the signal's content. NOT who
# collected or redistributed it, not the modality, not the task, not how it is
# Six values reached independently by all three phase-1 derivations
# (SYNTHESIS.md section 2). No `derived` value: all three refused or demoted one,
# and two independently stated the same inheritance rule -- a derived source
# carries its parents' values plus any the transformation introduces -- which is
# the `derived_from` relation already shipped in schema v5 (PR #106).
# `unknown` is a CODING STATE, not a node. An empty value set means "nothing

column4: the signal issues from a physical or biological process that would have run regardless of any intent to record it
column5: remove every human purpose and the process still runs and the signal still exists; an instrument stands between it and the record
column6: a human artifact or judgement arriving through an instrument is not natural -- the instrument is a channel, not an origin
column7: SDSS and LSST survey imaging; Protein Data Bank experimental structures; fastMRI raw k-space; Sentinel-2 imagery
column8: run A warned this value risks vacuity, since every photograph is a camera measurement; the test appeals to whether the capture pipeline is part of the source's identity

column4: human activity or artifacts produced for the actors' own purposes and collected afterwards
column5: the content would exist, unchanged, if this dataset had never been conceived
column6: fails if anyone was prompted, paid or instructed per item (elicited); curation and filtering do not change the origin -- selection is not origination
column7: Common Crawl and Wikipedia text; The Stack / GitHub code; Project Gutenberg; LAION and YFCC100M image-text pairs

column4: the signal exists because the collection asked for it; a person produced it to order
column5: there is a task description, protocol, prompt or payment that caused each item to be produced; remove the research request and the signal does not exist
column6: repurposed pre-existing human material stays human-incidental however aggressively it was filtered or reformatted
column7: ImageNet class labels; MS COCO annotations; SQuAD and SNLI; HH-RLHF preference comparisons; teleoperated robot demonstrations
column8: crowd versus expert is NOT a distinction on this axis -- annotation expertise is a separate characteristic

column4: values computed by executing a human-written mechanistic model of a real referent
column5: there is a solver or engine whose parameters have physical units, and 'the simulation is wrong' is a meaningful complaint about the output
column6: fails when nothing outside the program is modelled (constructed); fails when a LEARNED model produced it (model-generated)
column7: OC20 / ANI-1x DFT energies; PDEBench solver outputs; CMIP6 climate runs; MuJoCo rollouts; CARLA and Habitat rendered observations
column8: absorbs `rendered` (graphics from authored assets), which only run A proposed and held with low confidence. The open alternative: one `program-computed` value plus a separate `referent` axis

column4: values determined by a formal construction, grammar or random procedure with no empirical referent
column5: the generating specification IS the ground truth; there is no measurement or approximation error to speak of
column6: fails when a real phenomenon is being approximated (simulated)
column7: dSprites and Shapes3D factor grids; Dyck-k and PCFG string sets; Erdos-Renyi and stochastic-block-model graphs; BBOB analytic test functions
column8: boundary with `simulated` flagged by all three runs; Habitat is the recurring hard case (laser-measured real interiors, then rendered)

column4: content produced by sampling or predicting with a trained statistical model
column5: a model checkpoint stands in the causal chain that produced the content, not merely scoring or filtering it
column6: model-based filtering, dedup or ranking does not count; a model consulted LIVE during the run is catalogued as a model, not as a source -- see SYNTHESIS.md section 4
column7: Self-Instruct / Alpaca; Cosmopedia and phi-style generated corpora; Noisy-Student pseudo-labels; AlphaFold DB predicted structures used as data
column8: open: whether a model-based SELECTOR (FineWeb-Edu, DataComp) injects this value. Run A recorded it and said 'selection is not generation'

column4: values are records emitted as a byproduct of an organisation's or a system's operation, rather than authored or asked for
column5: the record exists because some system or institution had to conduct its business, and would exist had no one ever trained on it
column6: fails for content authored to be read (human-incidental) and for instrument records of nature (natural)
column7: MIMIC-III/IV clinical records; Criteo click logs; MovieLens and Netflix Prize ratings; Google Borg and Alibaba cluster traces; US Census
column8: FLAGGED, granularity unresolved: run A splits this into three (human interaction log / machine telemetry / institutional record), run B has one, run C has none. Both carriers volunteered low confidence. Phase 2 measures whether the corpus distinguishes them

column4: the signal is computed by a stated non-learned rule, verifier or engine
column5: a person could check the signal by applying a written rule, and the rule has no learned parameters
column6: fails if the producer has learned parameters (model-generated) or if a human judged case by case (elicited)
column7: unit-test pass/fail rewards; Lean or Coq proof checking; terminal outcomes from the rules of Go or chess; distant supervision by alignment to a knowledge base
column8: FLAGGED SPECULATIVE: only run B proposed it; A and C route game outcomes to `constructed`. Kept because its characteristic survives its own tests -- a unit test checks real code, so 'no empirical referent' is false of it. Rarity is not the test; coherence is

column4: a generating process none of the above describes
column5: a reviewer can say what produced the signal and why no value fits
column6: not the case where the paper does not say -- that is the `unknown` coding state
column7: none named on purpose; the hard candidate is an analog or quantum device whose output is both computed and measured
column8: the world/people/computation trichotomy is intended to be exhaustive, so this is expected to stay near-empty
